mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.status, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.project_id = p.id AND i.status != 'closed') AS open_issue_count, COALESCE(( SELECT STRING_AGG(u.display_name, ', ' ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id) FROM project_assignees pa JOIN users u ON u.id = pa.user_id WHERE pa.project_id = p.id ), '') AS assignee_names
mapper.select: SELECT FROM projects p ORDER BY CASE p.status WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 2 WHEN 'on_hold' THEN 3 WHEN 'archived' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, p.created_at DESC
SELECT user_id FROM project_assignees WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (name, status, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
